items.title: 'Bullied' and 'out of control' - Chelsea's defensive issues laid bare
items.description: "You need to feel it. We're not feeling it," said Xabi Alonso after Chelsea's 3-0 loss at Brentford. Yet Chelsea are stuck in a familiar feeling.

items.title: Kane racks up 100 Bundesliga goals in record time
'We're unpredictable' - Andrews delighted with 'brilliant' Brentford
items.description: Brentford manager Keith Andrews is full of praise after a resounding 3-0 win against West London rivals Chelsea, branding them "brilliant" following a unbeaten start to the Premier League campaign.

items.title: Chelsea miss Joao Pedro... and can't stop conceding goals
items.description: Chelsea's problem was defending, but with Joao Pedro ruled out through injury, scoring goals has also become an issue.

items.title: Kane makes history and Olise nets hat-trick as Bayern thrash Union Berlin
items.description: HHarry Kane makes history by becoming the fastest player to reach 100 Bundesliga goals in his 98th game, while Michael Olise nets a hat-trick as Bayern Munich thrash Union Berlin 7-0.

items.title: Arteta: Dowman could go out on loan in future
items.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months.

items.title: Brentford score three in dominant win over Chelsea to continue unbeaten start
items.description: Highlights from the Premier League match between Brentford and Chelsea.

items.title: Man City strike late to beat Liverpool and maintain perfect start
items.description: Man City come out on top of a thrilling WSL encounter against Liverpool, requiring two goals in the closing stages of the game to seal a 4-2 win, their third victory in three league fixtures so far this season.

items.title: Brentford stay unbeaten as they put three past Chelsea
items.description: Brentford maintain their unbeaten start in the Premier League as they score three second-half goals to beat Chelsea 3-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.
